result.instructions: Tools for Brandboom, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still open, and when do they ship?"; "Show me the invoices for showroom 12 from last month."; "Find the products with the keyword 'linen' and their wholesale prices.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Brandboom data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run brandboom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run brandboom_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run brandboom_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. brandboom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: brandboom_list_showrooms
tools.title: List showrooms
tools.description: List the showrooms this account can access, with their showroom ids. Other tools need a showroom id. Brandboom API: GET /v3/showrooms/search.

showroomIDs.description: Showroom ids to return. Omit to return all accessible showrooms.

tools.name: brandboom_list_price_tiers
tools.title: List price tiers
tools.description: List price tiers for the brands this account can access. Products need a price tier id. Brandboom API: GET /v3/priceTiers/search.

brandIDs.description: Brand ids to return. Omit to return price tiers for all accessible brands.

tools.name: brandboom_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search products with their descriptions, prices and SKUs, in one showroom and one price tier. Brandboom API: GET /v3/products/search.

priceTierID.description: Price tier id (from brandboom_list_price_tiers) for the prices returned.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based offset, to page through results.

tools.name: brandboom_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders by id, keyword, order date, ship date or status. Brandboom API: GET /v3/orders/search.

keywords.description: One or more keywords, separated by spaces (all must match).

status.description: Order status filters, for example open, processing, complete, void or not_shipped.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based offset, to page through results.

tools.name: brandboom_get_order_pdf
tools.title: Get an order PDF link
tools.description: Create the PDF of one order and return a temporary download link. The file is deleted 24 hours after it is made. Brandboom API: GET /v3/orders/pdf.

settings.description: Optional PDF display settings, as a JSON object string. Omit for the default layout.

tools.name: brandboom_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search customers by id, keyword, customer code, type (billing or shipping) or last change date. Brandboom API: GET /v3/customers/search.

types.description: Address types: "B" for billing, "S" for shipping.

dateModified.description: Return customers created or changed after this time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:II:SS.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based offset, to page through results.

tools.name: brandboom_search_invoices
tools.title: Search invoices
tools.description: Search invoices in one or more showrooms, by id, order, keyword or date. Brandboom API: GET /v3/invoices/search.

keywords.description: Search terms. Commas and line breaks separate independent searches.

showHistorical.description: true returns only past sales imported from another system. false returns only invoices made here.

includeOrders.description: true adds the related orders to the reply.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based offset, to page through results.

tools.name: brandboom_search_shipments
tools.title: Search shipments
tools.description: Find shipments by shipment ids or by invoice id, optionally filtered by status. Give shipmentIDs or invoiceID. Brandboom API: GET /v3/shipments/search.

invoiceID.description: Invoice id whose shipments to return.

status.description: Return only shipments with this status.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Brandboom
prompts.description: What you can do with Brandboom here, with example requests to try.
